# Requirements Quality Checklist: 003-component-catalog

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, completeness, and consistency of the 003-component-catalog specification across requirements, API contracts, UX flows, importer contracts, and security.
**Created**: 2026-09-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](/specs/003-component-catalog/spec.md) | [plan.md](/specs/003-component-catalog/plan.md)
**Depth**: standard
**Audience**: PR reviewer / spec author

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command. Items test the requirements themselves, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the exact pagination semantics documented, including the default page size and how `page`/`pageSize` map to database limits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are all five filter dimensions (category, provider, lifecycle, status, componentGroup) explicitly required and their multi-value semantics quantified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the search behavior for `externalId` defined as case-insensitive exact match, and not left to interpretation as partial or fuzzy? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are the exact component metadata fields shown on the detail page enumerated in the spec? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are the RBAC permissions for ComponentGroup management mapped to specific role names? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are all required `ComponentGroup` fields beyond name/slug (description, owner, lifecycle) explicitly listed with their constraints? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "server-driven pagination" clarified with the shape of the paginated response (e.g., total, pages, hasNext)? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the term "filters across different dimensions use AND" defined with a concrete example for two dimensions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the difference between `Component.lifecycle` and `ComponentInstance.status` unambiguously stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the meaning of `RETIRED` groups being "hidden by default and their components treated as ungrouped" defined for both API and UI? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the "default view" for the catalog explicitly defined, including which filters are implicitly applied? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 - Do the default catalog exclusions (`RETIRED` components, `GONE` instances) align with the two-level lifecycle/operational-state model in the constitution? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Constitution §IV]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the `ComponentGroup` owner requirement consistent with the user/Person model and RBAC without introducing an `Organization` entity? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK014 - Do the importer edge-case rules agree with the v2 scope exclusion for `DEPENDS_ON`/`SOURCES_FROM`/`EXPOSES` across the spec, plan, and constitution? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Constitution §V]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are the success criteria (SC-001–SC-004) consistent with the acceptance scenarios and task-level tests? [Consistency, Spec §Success Criteria, Plan §1]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 - Is the "under 30 seconds" target for locating a component by name or `externalId` measurable in isolation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the "1,000 components" responsive UI threshold defined with the specific page and interaction being measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the pass/fail criterion for new importer tests unambiguous about what "exercise its mocked source API" means? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the `pnpm test:unit` and `pnpm test:integration` success criterion scoped to the packages listed? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 - Are primary catalog-browse scenarios defined for authenticated users with no components, some components, and many components? [Coverage, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are alternate group-management scenarios documented for the viewer role (e.g., viewer attempting `POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE`)? [Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are exception scenarios for `ComponentGroup` slug collisions defined for both create and update? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Spec §Edge-Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are recovery/rollback scenarios described for failed importer runs that touch `components` and `component_instances`? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are the non-functional scenarios (performance under 1,000 components, no `sql.raw()`) captured in the plan as constraints or acceptance criteria? [Coverage, Plan §2, Plan §Constraints]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 - Is the zero-instances case explicitly surfaced as a requirement rather than an afterthought? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge-Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the `GONE` instance display requirement defined as an opt-in filter, and not conflated with deletion or hard removal? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge-Cases, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the slug-collision behavior for user-owned `ComponentGroup` slugs distinguished from importer-derived `Component` slug suffixes? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge-Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is the `OTHER` category/provider escape hatch explicitly allowed for all six new importers when classification is uncertain? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Edge-Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is the scenario where the same logical component appears from multiple providers defined as a separate `Component` per importer, with grouping as the only reconciliation path? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge-Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK030 - Are the performance targets (1s load for 1,000 components, 50 items per page) explicitly tied to the pagination and indexing strategy? [Completeness, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are the metrics requirements (component count and group count) described with the Prometheus metric names and labels? [Clarity, Plan §Scope, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the "no `sql.raw()`" and "all DB access via Kysely" constraint written as a binding requirement, not a suggestion? [Clarity, Plan §Constraints]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK033 - Does the spec state that the GitHub importer and 002 framework must be operational, and what happens if they are not? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is the assumption that the 24-value taxonomy and `OTHER` escape hatch are already in place from 002 validated rather than unchallenged? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are the product-hierarchy and component-to-component edge out-of-scope exclusions explicitly listed and not left implied? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Out of scope]

## API Contract Requirements

- [ ] CHK036 - Are the required query parameters and response shapes for `GET /api/v1/components` specified as an API contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Acceptance Criteria]
- [ ] CHK037 - Is the `PATCH /api/v1/components/:id` contract for `componentGroupId` assignment/unassignment defined, including which roles may call it? [Completeness, Plan §Acceptance Criteria]
- [ ] CHK038 - Are the `POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE /api/v1/component-groups` endpoints and their expected status codes documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Plan §Acceptance Criteria]
- [ ] CHK039 - Are error response codes and `code` enums for slug conflicts and RBAC denials specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §Edge-Cases]

## UX Requirements

- [ ] CHK040 - Are the frontend pages (`/components`, `/components/:id`, `/component-groups`) listed with the user flows they support? [Completeness, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK041 - Is the interaction for applying multiple filters from different dimensions described in terms of state requirements, not implementation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK042 - Is the component detail page requirement for showing `ComponentInstance` rows by environment unambiguous about which instance fields must be visible? [Clarity, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK043 - Are the UX requirements for group management (create/edit/delete/assign) consistent with the RBAC matrix for editors and admins? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Spec §US3]

## Importer Contract Requirements

- [ ] CHK044 - Is the `Importer.run` contract (`config`, `secrets`, `context`) and the `AsyncGenerator<DiscoveredAsset>` output explicitly required for all six importers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK045 - Is the requirement that importers never access `process.env` or the `SecretResolver` directly stated as enforceable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK046 - Is the `DiscoveredAsset` validation against `validateDiscoveredAsset` in `packages/core` required for every importer package? [Completeness, Constitution §VI]
- [ ] CHK047 - Is the prohibition on `DEPENDS_ON`/`SOURCES_FROM`/`EXPOSES` edges in `003` importers clearly scoped to the v2 roadmap? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Constitution §V]

## Security Requirements

- [ ] CHK048 - Are the exact role permissions for catalog read, group CRUD, and component assignment mapped to `VIEWER`/`EDITOR`/`ADMIN`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK049 - Are CSRF protection requirements for `POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` state-changing routes implicit or explicit? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK050 - Is the handling of `secretRefs` (e.g., `env:VAR_NAME`) for importers defined without exposing secrets in logs or API responses? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK051 - Is the scope of OIDC vs. local auth for the catalog/group UI documented, or is the requirement implementation-dependent? [Clarity, Gap]
